title: Host Protect
subtitle: Malware checks that run on your server. Not Guard and not SIEM.
featureOff: Host Protect is not enabled in this environment.
emptyHint: Add the folder of a site on a Guard agent. Checks run on that server; results stay here, not mixed with IP or domain scans.
name: Name
intervalHint: Hourly is optional. At most two checks run at once per organization. Only the site folder is checked — never the whole disk.
autoQuarantineOn: On — queue quarantine for new webshell/backdoor hits
autoQuarantineHint: Default off. When on, new critical hits are queued for the helper (not deleted). Restore remains available. Does not rewrite PHP or clone panel auto-clean.
siteEnabledHint: Off skips the beat schedule for this site. Scan now still works. This is not uninstall.
limitReached: Site limit reached for this SKU.
hitsWaitingAgent: Still checking on your server. Results are not in yet — do not treat this as clean.
hitsClean: No suspicious files in the folder it could check (up to 500 files, 1 MB each). This is not a guarantee for the whole server.
hitsHidden: Ignored files are hidden. Use Show ignored files to open the list. That does not mean the site is clean.
hitsUnlisted: This check recorded findings, but none appear in this list. Try Scan now. That does not mean the site is clean.
hitsUnreachable: The check did not finish on your server. Results appear only after that check sends them back.
scanQueued: Still checking on your server. Results are not in yet.
scanCompleted: Check finished. {{count}} file(s) still need a decision (quarantine or ignore).
scanCompletedNone: Check finished. No suspicious files in the folder it could check — not a clean server.
scanCompletedIgnored: Check finished. {{count}} file(s) match what you already marked Ignore — nothing new to decide.
scanCompletedUnlisted: Check finished. Findings were recorded but are not in this list. Try Scan now.
noAgents: Install a Guard agent first, then register a site here.
helperRequired: Adding a site does not scan the disk. Install the Host Protect helper on the Guard VPS (timer + token). Without a recent check-in from that helper, Scan now will not finish.
helperNeverPolled: The helper has not checked in from this agent yet.
helperStale: Helper last checked in {{when}} — more than 30 minutes ago. Scan now may fail until it runs again.
helperFleetNever: No Host Protect helper has checked in from a Guard agent yet. An empty list is not a clean server.
helperFleetStale: Host Protect helper last checked in {{when}} — more than 30 minutes ago. Empty lists here are not a clean result until it checks in again.
installHint: On the Guard VPS, download one file from sinexis.app. Do not clone the repo. Do not pipe curl into bash.
installCheck: The first line must start with #! — if you see HTML, the download failed.
honestyHint: Results come from a check that runs on your server. A waiting or failed check is not a clean result.
statusPendingQuarantine: Queued for helper — not quarantined yet
statusPendingRestore: Restore queued — still quarantined on disk
wafHint: HTTP filter per site — not the Malware tab. Off: no filter, Simulate stays off. Detect: log only after the snippet is on the customer VPS. Protect (Host Multi): block there. Mode in this UI does not block sinexis.app. Never paste the snippet onto the public edge.
wafFeatureOff: Host WAF is not enabled in this environment.
wafNeedSite: Add a Host Protect site first, then set WAF mode.
wafProtectLocked: Protect mode needs Host Multi. Basic can use detect only.
wafSimulateHint: Lab preview only. Adds a sample row so you can see the layout. It is not a live nginx hit. Turn mode to detect or protect first.
wafSimulateProdHint: Simulate is lab-only (fixture site). This table lists live helper posts (rules 1001–1044), not dashboard previews.
wafEventsHint: These rows are HTTP filter events, not Suspicious files. Live rows appear after the helper posts matches from nginx on your VPS — not from this dashboard.
wafEventsEmpty: No WAF events yet. Simulate is preview only. Live hits need the snippet on the VPS plus a helper poll that posts them here.
wafCopyHint: Clipboard only. Paste the include on the customer VPS — this button does not install or reload nginx.
wafCopyOk: Snippet copied. Do not paste onto sinexis.app edge nginx.
wafSnippetNotIncluded: Copying the snippet does not mean nginx already includes it. Until you paste the include on the customer VPS and reload nginx, live rows will not appear.
copySiteIdOk: Site UUID copied. Use it as --waf-site-id on the VPS (not the Guard agent id).
siteIdHint: This is Host Protect site id — not Guard. On the VPS: sudo ./sinexis-install.sh --configure-waf-ingest --waf-site-id {{id}}
wafHelperNever: The helper has not checked in from this site’s Guard agent yet. Live WAF rows wait on that check-in.
wafHelperStale: Helper last checked in {{when}} — older than 30 minutes. Live WAF rows may be delayed.
